evidence_summary: v14 independent re-run (seed=137, training seeds +1000/+2000) confirms v13 finding: linear_citation_concat passes frozen success rule (mean JP delta +0.0392 > 0.02, paired delta std 0.0212 < 0.03) across 5-fold CV. linear_hybrid05_w3070 consistently fails stability (v13: 0.0326, v14: 0.0618). MLP combinations unstable in both versions. Two-mode tradeoff persists (no combo beats baseline on both JP and CiteIndep). All 16 representations pass adversarial gates on all folds. Negative results honestly represented: JP target 0.8 not reached, CiteIndep tradeoff persists, CV JPs not comparable to true OOS, no jurist validation. Methodology sound: frozen harness v3 unchanged, baselines retrained per fold, citation features fit on train only, success rule pre-registered and unchanged. Finding promoted from EXPLORATORY to REPRODUCED tier.
